tests.test_scenario: Validate default settings initialization and typed field loading
tests.expected_result: Settings initialize with valid ENV, port, and database URL
tests.actual_result: Settings initialized successfully with production database URL

tests.test_scenario: Validate LOG_LEVEL validation and case-insensitivity rejection
tests.expected_result: Valid levels uppercase normalized; invalid levels raise ValueError
tests.actual_result: Normalized 'DEBUG' and 'ERROR'; raised ValueError on 'INVALID_LEVEL'

tests.test_scenario: Validate root platform overview endpoint
tests.expected_result: Returns HTTP 200 with application title, version 3.2.0, and operational status
tests.actual_result: HTTP 200 returned with correct platform metadata payload

tests.test_scenario: Validate lightweight liveness endpoint /health/live without external dependencies
tests.expected_result: Returns HTTP 200 with status=ok and UTC ISO timestamp
tests.actual_result: HTTP 200 returned immediately without blocking on network services

tests.test_scenario: Validate readiness endpoint /health/ready independent of GPU availability
tests.expected_result: Returns HTTP 200 with database latency and S3 health; GPU omitted from readiness contract
tests.actual_result: HTTP 200 with healthy Neon DB ping and S3 bucket health; GPU not gating readiness

tests.test_scenario: Validate capabilities endpoint /health/capabilities reporting GPU VRAM & subsystems
tests.expected_result: Returns HTTP 200 with PyTorch CUDA RTX 3050 hardware specs, DB stats, and storage stats
tests.actual_result: HTTP 200 reporting NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 6GB Laptop GPU, CUDA 12.4, and uninitialized worker

tests.test_scenario: Validate Prometheus /metrics endpoint formatting and metric registration
tests.expected_result: Returns HTTP 200 with Prometheus text exposition including http_requests and latency histograms
tests.actual_result: HTTP 200 returned with ledgerone_http_requests_total and histogram buckets

tests.test_scenario: Validate automatic X-Request-ID header generation when omitted by client
tests.expected_result: Response contains valid generated UUID in X-Request-ID header
tests.actual_result: Header X-Request-ID present with valid UUID4 string

tests.test_scenario: Validate client-provided X-Request-ID header preservation and propagation
tests.expected_result: Inbound request ID returned unchanged in response headers
tests.actual_result: X-Request-ID matched inbound client header 'test-custom-request-id-98765'

tests.test_scenario: Validate custom domain exception JSON envelope formatting (TenantIsolationError)
tests.expected_result: Returns HTTP 403 with error code TENANT_ISOLATION_ERROR, message, and request_id
tests.actual_result: HTTP 403 formatted correctly with envelope details and request_id

tests.test_scenario: Validate NotFoundError centralized exception handler JSON envelope
tests.expected_result: Returns HTTP 404 with error code RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND
tests.actual_result: HTTP 404 with standard error envelope and RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND code

tests.test_scenario: Validate unhandled internal exception interception without leaking stack trace
tests.expected_result: Returns HTTP 500 with generic INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR message and request_id
tests.actual_result: HTTP 500 returned with generic message and request_id; exception logged internally

tests.test_scenario: Validate connection pool reuse leaves zero residual tenant state across transactions
tests.expected_result: Successive acquisitions from pool have clean empty session settings
tests.actual_result: Tenant setting app.current_org_id reverted to empty string upon connection release

tests.test_scenario: Validate 10 concurrent requests executing with distinct tenant identities
tests.expected_result: Zero race conditions or cross-tenant contamination across parallel coroutines
tests.actual_result: All 10 concurrent tasks observed strictly their own assigned tenant identity

tests.test_scenario: Validate cross-organization Row-Level Security isolation across SELECT, UPDATE, DELETE
tests.expected_result: Org B receives 0 rows when attempting to view, modify, or delete Org A's document
tests.actual_result: Org A viewed 1 row; Org B received 0 rows on SELECT, UPDATE 0, DELETE 0

tests.test_scenario: Validate cross-workspace Row-Level Security isolation within the same organization
tests.expected_result: Member of Workspace 1 cannot view documents residing in Workspace 2
tests.actual_result: User viewed Document 1 in assigned workspace; Document 2 returned 0 rows

tests.test_scenario: Validate unprivileged role execution enforces rolbypassrls=False
tests.expected_result: Role ledgerone_app executes with rolbypassrls=False
tests.actual_result: current_user confirmed ledgerone_app with rolbypassrls=False

tests.test_scenario: Validate fail-closed security when tenant context is omitted
tests.expected_result: Queries against documents, organizations, and workspaces return 0 rows
tests.actual_result: Returned exactly 0 rows across all tenant entities without tenant context

tests.test_scenario: Validate transaction-scoped setting lifecycle with automatic post-commit reversion
tests.expected_result: app.current_org_id setting active during transaction and reverted after commit
tests.actual_result: Setting active inside transaction; automatically reverted to empty string post-commit

tests.test_scenario: Validate transaction-scoped setting reversion upon transaction rollback
tests.expected_result: Simulated error triggers rollback and completely clears transaction-local settings
tests.actual_result: Setting reverted to empty string immediately after rollback exception
